```{r}
check_correlations <- function(mat){
  mat_corr <- cor(mat)
  mat_corr_diag <- mat_corr[lower.tri(mat_corr)]
  print(paste("Maximum correlation in the matrix:", round(max(mat_corr_diag),3)))
  print(paste("Minimum correlation in the matrix:", round(min(mat_corr_diag),3)))
  pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_corr, show_rownames = F, show_colnames = F)
}
```

```{r}
get_analysis_df_from_module <- function(module, data){
  correlations <- data %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id",module$features))) %>% 
                tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% cor() %>% 
                as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("feature.x") %>% 
                tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature.x, names_to = "feature.y", values_to = "r")

  df <- module$module_edge %>% 
    left_join(correlations, by = c("feature.x", "feature.y")) %>% 
    tidyr::separate(feature.x, into = c("prefix.x", "feature.x"), sep = "__", extra = "merge") %>% 
    tidyr::separate(feature.y, into = c("prefix.y", "feature.y"), sep = "__", extra = "merge") %>% 
    left_join(compound_names, by = c("feature.x" = "compound_id")) %>%
    left_join(compound_names, by = c("feature.y" = "compound_id")) %>%
    mutate(feature_1 = ifelse(is.na(compound_name.x), feature.x, compound_name.x),
           feature_2 = ifelse(is.na(compound_name.y), feature.y, compound_name.y))
  return(df)
}

plot_graph <- function(df, prefix_mapping = c("T" = "Genus", "M" = "Metabolite") ){
  edges <- df %>% select(feature_1, feature_2, edge_weight, r)
  nodes <- rbind(df %>% select(feature_1, prefix.x) %>% rename(name = feature_1, Omic = prefix.x),
               df %>% select(feature_2, prefix.y) %>% rename(name = feature_2, Omic = prefix.y)) %>% unique() %>% 
         mutate(omic = prefix_mapping[Omic])
  g <- tidygraph::tbl_graph(edges = edges, nodes = nodes, directed = F) 
  
  layout <- create_layout(g, layout = 'igraph', algorithm = 'nicely')
  p1 <-ggraph(layout) + 
    geom_edge_fan(aes(color = r), alpha = 0.3, width = 2, position = "jitter", label_dodge = T) +
    #scale_edge_color_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "grey30") +  
    scale_edge_color_gradient2(low = "#2a428b", mid = "#eff7f6", high = "#BF3C6F", midpoint = 0, 
                              limits = c(-1, 1), name = "R") +
    geom_node_point(aes(fill = omic), size = 6, shape = 21, alpha = 0.9) + 
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 4.5, check_overlap = T) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Metabolite" = "grey30", "Genus" = "grey60", "Blood Test" = "grey10")) + 
    #scale_color_manual(values = c("Metabolite" = "#f4a261", "Genus" = "#2a9d8f")) + 
    labs(edge_color = "R", fill = "Omic") + 
    theme_void()
  return(p1)
}
```

ggdata <- data %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id",module$features)))

results <- get_binary_predictability(ggdata, mdata, "patient_id", c("is_fap"))
df_roc_plot <- results$plots$is_fap$data %>% mutate(shuffled_flag == "True model", "", )

aucs <- results$results
auc_true <- paste(round(aucs$mean_auc_true_model,2), "\u00B1", round(aucs$sd_auc_true_model,2))
auc_null <- paste(round(aucs$mean_auc_shuffled_model,2), "\u00B1", round(aucs$sd_auc_shuffled_model,2))
label <- paste0("AUC (True model): ", auc_true, "\nAUC (Null models): ", auc_null)

p4 <- ggplot(df_roc_plot, aes(x = x, group = shuffle_index)) +
  geom_path(aes(y = `median`, color = shuffled_flag), size =1.2) + 
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", alpha=0.9, color = "grey10", size = 1) + 
  scale_x_reverse() + #coord_equal() + 
  labs(x = 'Specificity', y = 'Sensitivity', fill = "", color = "", alpha = "", subtitle = label) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = shuffled_flag, alpha = shuffled_flag)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c('Null models' = 0.2, 'True model' = 0.4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('Null models' = 'grey60', 'True model' = '#2F5A91')) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('Null models' = 'grey60', 'True model' = '#2F5A91')) +theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```{r}
matched_compounds <- read.csv( "processed_data/compound_id_to_ko.csv")
pathways <- read.csv("processed_data/pathways_annotated.csv")

pathway_metabolite_overlap <- pathways %>% filter(kegg_id %in% matched_compounds$kegg_id) %>% count(pathway_id) %>% 
                              filter(n >=3) %>% pull(pathway_id)
pathway_sizes <- pathways %>% filter(pathway_id %in% pathway_metabolite_overlap) %>% group_by(pathway_id) %>% summarise(pathway_size = n()) %>% ungroup()
pathways_filt <- pathways %>% filter(pathway_id %in% pathway_metabolite_overlap) %>% 
                 group_by(pathway_name) %>% mutate(n = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
                 filter(n <= 200)
                
```

```{r}
ggplot(pathway_sizes, aes(x= pathway_size)) + geom_density() + scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200)
```

```{r}
a<- pathways %>% filter(kegg_id %in% target_kegg)
```


```{r}
target_metabolites <- grep("M__",module$features, value = T) %>% gsub("M__","", .)
target_kegg <- matched_compounds %>% filter(compound_id %in% target_metabolites) %>% pull(kegg_id)
all_metabolites <- pathways_filt$kegg_id %>% unique()
```

```{r}
# Get unique pathways
unique_pathways <- unique(pathways_filt$pathway_name )

# Initialize results
ora_results <- data.frame(pathway = character(),
                          n_overlap = numeric(),
                          pathway_size = numeric(), 
                          p_value = numeric(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (pw in unique_pathways) {
  pw_metabolites <- pathways$kegg_id[pathways$pathway_name == pw]
  
  # Construct contingency table
  a <- sum(target_kegg %in% pw_metabolites)                  # in cluster AND in pathway
  b <- sum(target_kegg %in% all_metabolites & !(target_kegg %in% pw_metabolites))  # in cluster NOT in pathway
  c <- sum(!(all_metabolites %in% target_kegg) & (all_metabolites %in% pw_metabolites))    # not in cluster BUT in pathway
  d <- sum(!(all_metabolites %in% target_kegg) & !(all_metabolites %in% pw_metabolites))   # neither

  contingency <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2)

  # Fisher's test
  test <- fisher.test(contingency, alternative = "greater")

  # Save result
  ora_results <- rbind(ora_results,
                       data.frame(pathway = pw,
                                  n_overlap = a,
                                  pathway_size = length(pw_metabolites),
                                  p_value = test$p.value,
                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

# Adjust p-values
ora_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(ora_results$p_value, method = "fdr")

```
